runs: Calculates the acquisition tax (취득세) you pay when buying
in Korea. This doesn't apply to inheritance/gift acquisitions or non-residential property (land, commercial units, etc.).
For a first (single) home, the rate is 1% up to ₩600M, 3% above ₩900M, and in between (₩600M–900M) it's calculated with
— designed to land exactly on 1% at ₩600M and 3% at ₩900M.

blocks.text: Surcharge rates for multiple homes / corporations

items: Corporation: always 12%, regardless of how many properties
Regulated (조정대상) area: 8% for a 2nd home, 12% for a 3rd or more
Non-regulated area: base rate for a 1st–2nd home, 8% for a 3rd, 12% for a 4th or more

If this is your first home ever and the price is ₩1.2B or under, up to ₩2M of the calculated tax is waived (up to ₩3M for a small, lower-priced home: 60㎡ or under and ₩600M/₩300M or under in metro/non-metro areas). The income requirement was removed in a 2023 amendment, but you must move in within 3 months and live there for at least 3 years, or the relief can be clawed back.
